这不是最简单的事情。您可能需要从互联网上获取一堆节点。

我发现使用 FLUX 与 GGUF Q3_K_S 模型和 t5-11 的 Q3_K_M 获得绝对最佳结果，甚至比使用完整版本时更好。大约需要 8 Gvram，或多或少。

https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/tree/main

https://huggingface.co/city96/FLUX.1-dev-gguf/tree/main

它与基础通量一起工作没有任何问题，只是需要更长的时间并消耗更多的硬件。

我用一些 SDXL 像素艺术模型对其进行了测试，它需要更大的尺寸才能开始，但它可以使用......有点。情况不太好。

如果使用 ComfyUI Manager 获取节点时出现任何重大错误或问题，请告诉我。

这是核心完整图像提示。它适用于一切。

尽量不要把它搞得太乱。有点挑剔啊

这是行特定的逻辑。每行都会得到这个，并且设置将匹配 <`SUBJECT`> 的字符串替换为该行的蓝色特定标记列表。这是每行之间共享的提示。如果存在某种标签冲突，工作流程中的上面有一个部分，您可以在其中修改或更改它。

每个蓝色提示定义行细节。

每一行都有自己的逻辑，并且可以根据强度进行修改。对于某些类型的像素艺术和像素类型有点挑剔。主题可以修改、更改、变更等等，但效果还不错。

如果您遇到任何重大怪癖或问题，您可以参考原始工作流程来修复它。

为了方便起见，我在最后连接了一个背景去除剂，但我真的不确定它的效果如何。如果节点引起问题，您可以完全删除它们。

o.en:
This isn't the most simple thing to work with. You'll likely need to fetch a bunch of nodes from around the internet.

I found the absolute best results using FLUX with GGUF Q3_K_S model and the Q3_K_M for the t5-11, even better than when working with the full version. It takes about 8 gigs vram, give or take.

https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/tree/main

https://huggingface.co/city96/FLUX.1-dev-gguf/tree/main

It works with base flux without any problems it just takes longer and consumes more hardware.

I tested it with a few SDXL pixel art models and it requires a higher size to begin, but it can be used... kind of. It's not as good.

If there are any major errors or problems with using ComfyUI Manager to get the nodes let me know.

Here is the core full image prompt. It's applied to everything.

Try not to mess with it TOO MUCH. It's kinda picky.

This is the row specific logic. Each row gets this, and the setup is replacing the string matching <`SUBJECT`> with the row's specific tag list in blue. This is a shared prompt between each row. There's a section above in the workflow where you can tinker or change it if there's some sort of tag conflict.

Each blue prompt defines row specifics.

Each row has it's own logic and it can be tinkered with strength-wise. It's a bit picky for certain types of pixel arts and pixel types. The themes can be modified, changed, altered and so on, but it works okay.

If you run into any major quirks or problems you can consult the original workflow to fix it.

I hooked a background remover at the end for convenience but I'm really not sure how well it'll work. You can remove the nodes entirely if they are causing problems.
